title: POPANE-P0 Study 6 outcome-blind remote schema preflight
purpose: Determine whether public POPANE Study 6 can support an independent prospective valence replication of the CASE incremental-information result without downloading/extracting the full 2.7 GB archive.

source.published_design: Baseline, series of six film clips (positive, negative, neutral or mixed), ultimatum game.

allowed_preflight_reads: HTTP response headers and range-support status
ZIP central-directory filenames, compressed/uncompressed sizes and directory structure
CSV header rows only (column names) from a small deterministic sample of entries
First two non-data metadata/comment lines only if required to identify delimiter or schema; do not inspect valence or physiology values
forbidden_before_followup_freeze: No selective participant exclusion based on outcomes

deterministic_sampling.file_selection: Sort all CSV entry paths lexicographically; inspect headers of the first 12 non-baseline/manipulation-like CSV files plus up to 3 baseline files if present.
deterministic_sampling.objective: Establish participant/file naming, phase segmentation, timestamp column, valence column, marker/stimulus columns, and physiology-channel names.

qc_questions: Does the server support byte ranges so selective remote ZIP access is feasible?
Are participant IDs recoverable from filenames?
Can film/manipulation segments be identified independently of valence values?
Is continuous valence present in the same files as at least ECG and EDA?
Is there a usable time/timestamp/sample index?
Are there enough distinct participant and film/manipulation files to preregister held-out-person and held-out-stimulus or held-out-condition evaluation?

decisions.PASS_REMOTE_REPLICATION_FEASIBLE: Range access works; schema exposes synchronized continuous valence + >=2 peripheral channels + participant IDs + independently identifiable stimulus/phase structure.
decisions.PASS_PERSON_ONLY_GENERALIZATION: Continuous valence+physiology and participant IDs are usable but stimulus identity cannot be cleanly recovered for double holdout.
decisions.FAIL_SCHEMA_OR_ACCESS: Range access/download or required synchronized schema is not viable.

firewall: Outcome-blind feasibility/QC only. A successful preflight does not test the scientific hypothesis. The replication protocol must be frozen in a later commit before reading valence/physiology values.
